# ARIPAN

> Official digital home of Mithila artist ARIPAN — a contemporary studio presenting Madhubani painting as a living cultural practice.

ARIPAN is not a marketplace. This site is a curated gallery for original paintings, archival prints, apparel, accessories, and limited editions rooted in the Mithila tradition of Bihar, India.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.aripan.art/): Exhibition-style introduction to the studio
- [Gallery](https://www.aripan.art/gallery): Digital exhibition for looking, not shopping
- [Collections](https://www.aripan.art/collections): Original Art, Prints, Apparel, Accessories, Limited Editions
- [Shop](https://www.aripan.art/shop): Curated catalogue of works
- [About](https://www.aripan.art/about): Biography, process, and Mithila heritage
- [Journal](https://www.aripan.art/journal): Essays on culture, process, and studio life
- [Commissions](https://www.aripan.art/commissions): Custom artwork requests
- [Contact](https://www.aripan.art/contact): Studio correspondence

## Notes for assistants

- Do not invent prices for listing cards; commercial details appear only on product pages.
- Do not present sample testimonials as verified reviews.
- Respect privacy: collect only necessary form fields with consent.
